title: Validating HTTP Semantics in REST APIs With Constructed Call Sequence Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2608.16239v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: REST APIs are widely used in industry. These APIs use HTTP for their communications. Failures in following the specifications of HTTP can lead to confusing and hard to use APIs, with possibly serious software faults with dire consequences. Objectives: Define novel automated techniques to automatically find HTTP semantics-level faults in existing REST APIs. Methods: We extended the state-of-the-art fuzzer EvoMaster with 9 new oracles to detect HTTP semanticslevel faults. Once the standard fuzzing process is finished generating N test cases, a new phase is executed in which these N tests are used as a starting point to create new scenarios (i.e., new sequences of HTTP calls) aimed at validating specific HTTP properties defined in these 9 oracles. translated_title: 在REST API中通过构造调用序列场景验证HTTP语义
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16239v1 公告类型：新 摘要：背景：REST API在工业界广泛使用。这些API使用HTTP进行通信。未遵循HTTP规范可能导致API混乱且难以使用，并可能引发严重的软件故障，带来严重后果。目标：定义新颖的自动化技术，以自动发现现有REST API中的HTTP语义级故障。方法：我们扩展了最先进的模糊测试工具EvoMaster，添加了9个新的预言器来检测HTTP语义级故障。当标准模糊测试过程生成N个测试用例后，执行一个新阶段，在该阶段中，这N个测试作为起点来创建新场景（即新的HTTP调用序列），旨在验证这9个预言器中定义的特定HTTP属性。结果：在9个注入故障的人工API上的实验表明，我们的新颖技术能够成功检测所有故障。在WFD语料库中36个API上的进一步实验表明，这些技术有效。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过扩展模糊测试工具EvoMaster并添加9个新预言器来自动检测REST API中HTTP语义级故障的新方法，实验证明其能有效发现所有注入故障。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel approach that extends the fuzzer EvoMaster with 9 new oracles to automatically detect HTTP semantics-level faults in REST APIs, demonstrated to successfully detect all injected faults in experiments.
